attacks.name: Neurokinetic Arrows
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Neural Connection|: After this attack is resolved, this character may put a Neural Connection token on the defender.

attacks.name: Psionic Salvo
steps: |!critical| |!wild| |*Rapid Shot|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Psionic Salvo| attack without paying the |!power| cost. This additional attack may not target the original defender and does not have the |*Rapid Shot| special rule.

superPowers.name: Coming of Age (Affiliation: New Mutants)
superPowers.body: When an allied character flips its Stat Card to the Injured side, it gains 3 |!power| and a Self-Discovery token. A character that has a Self-Discovery token adds 3 dice to its defense and dodge rolls. When a character that has a Self-Discovery token ends its Activation, remove that token from it.

superPowers.name: Figment of Fantasy
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 1 or an enemy character within |!range| 5 that has a Neural Connection token. Advance the chosen character |!movement_small|. Then remove all Neural Connection tokens from the chosen character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Telepathic Emotion Manifestation
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 1 or an enemy character within |!range| 5 that has a Neural Connection token is attacking, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may use this superpower. This character rerolls 2 of the attacking character's dice. Then remove all Neural Connection tokens from the attacking character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Neural Connection
superPowers.body: This character can have only 1 Neural Connection token in play. When this character would put a Neural Connection token on a character, if that token is already in play, it may move it to that character instead.
